name: NPC presentation
summary: How villagers look and show what they are doing: model variety by role, gender and genre, animation intents, activity labels and nameplates, a talking bubble, head turns toward the player, idle fidgets and gestures between lines, and lip sync from visemes or text.

parameters.doc: how long watching an activity counts as observing it

extensionPoints.doc: a world's own bodies by role_gender_N keys
the body's own gesture clips, chosen by name
TTS visemes, or dialogue text, drive the jaw

assistant.summary: Core decides what is shown and when (src/npc-life/presentation.ts; model choice in game-engine/logic/NPCModelVariety.ts and NPCModelManifest.ts); the engine draws it.
notes: An animation is one of core's 24 intents on the order; the clip, blend and state machine are the engine's.
Fidgets and talker gestures are overlays over the wanted clip; they never run while walking, seated or at a station.
doNot: Stream frames into core: hand it elapsed time and the clips a body has.
